The TypeScript client for the Shop API (`example.shop#Shop`, API version `v1`, sent as `Crucible-Version: v1` on every request), generated by [Crucible](https://github.com/Operation-Leyline/crucible) from the service's model.

## Install

```sh
npm install @example/shop-v1@0.0.0-dev
```

The package is `@example/shop-v1`, version `0.0.0-dev`; code refers to it as `@example/shop-v1`.

## Create a client

```ts
import { ShopClient } from "@example/shop-v1";
import type * as models from "@example/shop-v1";

const client = new ShopClient({ endpoint: process.env.SHOP_ENDPOINT });
```

The service declares no authentication. `endpoint` is the service's base URL. The client sends `Crucible-Version: v1` on every request.

## Call an operation

`countItems` calls `CountItems`. Every operation has a method like it.

```ts
import { CountUnavailableException, ShopClient } from "@example/shop-v1";
import type * as models from "@example/shop-v1";

// The client sends Crucible-Version: v1 on every request.
const client = new ShopClient({ endpoint: process.env.SHOP_ENDPOINT });

// Sample values generated from the model's types and constraints.
const input: models.CountItemsInput = {
  shelf: "shelf",
};

try {
  const output = await client.countItems(input);
  console.log(output.count);
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof CountUnavailableException) {
    console.error(`CountUnavailableException (HTTP ${error.$metadata.status}):`, error.message);
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Errors

Each modelled error is a class exported from the package, extending `ShopException` and `ServiceError`: test it with `instanceof` and read its fields and `$metadata.status`. Transport failures throw `NetworkError`; an exhausted `timeoutMs` throws `TimeoutError`.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. Set `retry: { maxAttempts }` in the client configuration to change the attempt limit (3, the first included), or `retry: false` to turn retries off.
